verdict.rationale: Chart-of-accounts customization is a fair question for accounting software like FreeAgent, but nothing in the evidence pack documents custom account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions. The only related item is smart categorisation of transactions, which is an adjacent feature and does not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
